value.rationale: A natural complete classification of the first nontrivial logical depth of the fundamental symmetric-group family in a carefully fixed relational group language, with six exact equivalence classes, a sharp stabilization degree eight, and a structural explanation by the first square-rootable 4-torsion element. The sharp boundary is not determined merely by orders of elements: rank two simultaneously probes an element’s square order and the existence of square roots through separate quantifier branches. The result also illustrates sharply different bounded-depth behavior from alternating subgroups, motivating the exact family invariant without demanding a separate downstream theorem.
